concerns.text: Task **T001c-impl** is marked `[P]` and listed in Phase 0, but it is **BLOCKED BY** foundational task **T002** (Phase 1). This creates a consumer‑before‑producer ordering violation; T001c-impl must be scheduled after T002 (or the BLOCKED BY clause removed).

Tasks **T001b-ii**, **T001b-iii**, **T001b-iv**, and **T001c-impl** are all tagged `[P]` yet they share a common prerequisite: the root directory created by **T001b-i**. Because they write to overlapping filesystem locations, they are not truly parallel‑safe. Either remove the `[P]` tag or add explicit dependencies (e.g., BLOCKED BY T001b-i) to enforce correct ordering.
